title: Flydubai Fallout Spreads, JetBlue's Bonds Get Shaky, and American Kills First Class
summary: The flydubai cockpit attack keeps sending shockwaves through the industry — United restricts crew by nationality, a new confession reveals years of planning, and an Egyptian pilot's video raises eyebrows at the worst possible time. Plus, JetBlue's loyalty program debt is getting nervous looks from lenders, Delta posts record revenue but slashes its profit outlook, and American officially kills off first class on its biggest plane.
